scope.invariant: Independent schema-3 native storage admits only supported durable ledger transactions, atomically preserves values/provenance/receipts and revocation state, rejects damaged/bounded data, and keeps a running blocking job permit after its asynchronous waiter is cancelled.
scope.selectedChain: PluginAuthority::new/with -> PluginStore::open -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> schema/read bounds -> injected runtime change -> bounded table writes -> COMMIT -> return; product snapshot/revoke command dispatch tails move owned capacity permits into blocking closures.
allowedPaths: Previously audited runtime Store contract and authority identity/epoch validation
exclusions: Independent named broker commit/revoke/version/idempotency and complete IPC/ACL audit
PackageFiles recovery/filesystem durability, native consent and exact target admission
All S15 command schedulers/executor/network barrier implementations
Actual WebView invocation/cancellation, application/browser/emulator launch, crash/power-loss and device/filesystem durability acceptance

declaredStatus.claim: Application storage owns an independent plugins.sqlite3 schema 3; Store transactions serialize durable ledger changes, reject unknown schemas/damaged authority and keep executing blocking-task permits across canceled waits.
declaredStatus.evidenceLimit: Actual native SQLite adapter tests plus scoped headless dispatch evidence. Historical stage counts are not used as current acceptance.

checks.question: Is installation authority stored independently under the native application owner?
checks.detail: PluginAuthority chooses plugins.sqlite3 and plugin-packages below its native directory, initializes lazily and composes PluginStore/NativeClock/NativeIds. Its independent empty-directory creation/recovery test passes. Product/accounts/credentials are not imported by this adapter.

checks.question: Do running snapshot/revoke blocking jobs retain the sole owned permit if their async waiter is aborted?
checks.detail: Both production dispatch tails capture OwnedSemaphorePermit inside spawn_blocking. Headless tests abort an active waiter, observe no available permit while the controlled job remains blocked, then release it and reacquire only after completion. Revoke persists the disabled/grantless state and calls network cancellation before its job releases capacity.
checks.limit: The exact dispatch tails and real tauri::async_runtime are used with a headless authority/action adapter. No real WebView command, OS process cancellation, network teardown or complete S15 scheduler coverage is claimed.

checks.question: Are authority changes, values, labels and receipts committed atomically before returning success?
checks.detail: BEGIN IMMEDIATE encloses load/change/all table replacement/COMMIT; synchronous FULL and DELETE journal are configured. Return happens only after COMMIT. Existing before-commit failures and a new payload-budget failure preserve the old generation; two real SQLite connections serialize updates without losing either writer. Durable revocation and restart receipt/history behavior pass.
checks.limit: No power-loss, disk-full/fsync fault, process-kill or supported-device storage-medium acceptance was performed; named-operation semantics remain the next batch.

checks.question: Do current-only schema, malformed authority and resource budgets fail closed while preserving existing data?
checks.detail: Fresh databases directly create schema 3 and the revocation authority row. Versions 1/2/99, nonempty schema 0, runtime schema changes, missing tables, malformed or identity-mismatched grants, missing revocation authority and row/payload exhaustion reject operations without overwriting retained records. No callback runs after read-time schema/table/row rejection. PluginAuthority caches failures as unavailable without deleting the DB.

checks.question: Does the current evidence exercise the actual owner with explicit limits?
checks.detail: Nine current SQLite tests and one native composition test pass through the production application test target. Ten additional local probes pass: eight use the unchanged native SQLite adapter and two use unchanged production dispatch tails. Scoped formatting passes; all source hashes remain unchanged. Root final gates, production builds and live UI evidence are not substituted for these checks.
